impact_assessment.risks: contract: public kernel/CLI helper signatures; dependency: none new (pure helpers in existing headers); concurrency: Vulkan fence-timeout paths; state: process-global multiprefix table and ledger.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first test per fix, full suite + 4/4 gates after each, codebase map regenerated, no commit/push without authorization.
